integrity_rules: A record is a claim about the First Team, not First Team state by default.
Preserve exact claim wording where lawfully and practically available, speaker/source, claim time, population scope and source lineage.
Do not promote a representation claim to DIRECT_PUBLIC_DECISION.
Do not convert sampled opinion into direct public decision evidence.
Do not infer whole-public representativeness from a mobilisation event.
Append corrections or contradiction records; do not silently overwrite prior claim state.
